summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.toReversed in its own file, following the spec steps 1 to 6 in order. ToObject and LengthOfArrayLike are called with `?`. ArrayCreate runs before the loop, so the RangeError for oversized lengths comes from it. The loop computes `from` then `propertyKey` (both pure ToString, so ordering is not observable), performs Get with `?`, and then CreateDataPropertyOrThrow with `?`. Each step keeps its spec comment directly above its code. Nothing is special-cased, no value is made up, and no error is swallowed. The only deviation I noticed is that step 5.d says `!` CreateDataPropertyOrThrow and the code uses `?`. This is behaviourally equivalent because the define on a fresh extensible array with index < length cannot fail, so I did not count it as a contradiction. Gate results (26 new passes, 0 regressions) are consistent with a real implementation.
